label: Annual ISA allowance
context: The total you can pay into all your ISAs each tax year. It stays at £20,000. From 6 April 2027, investors aged under 65 will be able to put up to £12,000 of it into cash ISAs.

label: Cash ISA limit for under-65s from 6 April 2027
context: Within the overall £20,000 ISA allowance, which stays the same. The regulations that bring in the lower limit are due to come into force on 6 April 2027.
